name: c2o
description: A skill suite for turning ambiguous knowledge, creative, or software work into the smallest verified outcome.

interface.shortDescription: Turn rough requests into verified outcomes.
interface.longDescription: C2O provides eleven coordinated skills for shaping ambiguous knowledge, creative, or software work, stress-testing decisions, exploring and refining creative directions, delivering non-software outcomes, implementing software safely, verifying evidence, and preserving useful learning.
defaultPrompt: Turn this rough request into the smallest verified outcome.
Explore and refine this creative brief into a verified artifact.
Deliver the smallest useful outcome from this approved brief.
